workflow.name: Competitor research brief
workflow.description: Crawls a competitor's site with Firecrawl and writes a positioning brief (offer, pricing, audience, gaps).

nodes.label: Crawl the site
nodes.prompt:
Use the Firecrawl API to read the most important pages of {{inputs.url}} (home, pricing, product/features, about).

POST https://api.firecrawl.dev/v1/scrape with `Authorization: Bearer $FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` and {"url": <page>, "formats":["markdown"]} for each page (find page URLs from the homepage links). Never print the key. Save each page to "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/<slug>.md".

Output: the key facts you found, per page, as terse notes.

nodes.label: Write the brief
